renderedNativeFailure.classification: Native functional failure, not setup failure or baseline regression. Strict test gate stops later performance checker in same workflow step. Missing evidence-validation.json means hosted persisted-pickup readback was not reached, not that readback itself failed. Incomplete rendered attachments also prevent independent complete measurement validation.
